items.description:
The system landscape moves from depth to breadth: four anchor cases expose the runtime in detail, the evidence matrix applies one comparison scheme, and the directory preserves the wider ecosystem of systems, substrates, modules, and evaluation infrastructure. The comparison set is evidence-driven and open-ended; 34 is the current result of the inclusion rule, not a target or a claim of completeness. Product form is not an exclusion rule: workplace and personal agents belong when their runtime architecture is documented well enough to assess.
The 34-system comparison set uses five reporting groups (4/10/5/7/8); names shown are selective examples except for the four anchors. The four adjacent analysis units are outside this runtime matrix. Membership does not establish performance or safety.

children.title: OpenClaw
children.description: An always-on personal-agent harness organized around channels, sessions, tools, skills, memory, scheduled work, gateway routing, and sandboxed execution. It makes deployment continuity central: identity, credentials, background jobs, workspace state, and operational policy persist beyond a single chat turn. That operating model makes it a key case for studying durable personal agents rather than one-shot assistants.

repo_info.description: The AI that really does things. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞

children.title: DeepSeek Harness
children.description: A plugin-native runtime in which model adapters, loops, tools, context projection, storage, telemetry, and interfaces are composed through profiles, bundles, and ordered patches. These boundaries let teams replace and audit the loop, context policy, tool behavior, and observability separately. The architecture, tool subsystem, and compaction design also provide a concrete base for bounded, evaluated, reversible harness-level improvement.

repo_info.description: DeepSeek Harness: Everything is a Plugin.

children.title: Claude Code
children.description: A vertically integrated coding harness that joins repository inspection, edits, commands, web and MCP tools, subagents, skills, hooks, permissions, checkpoints, and session continuation. Its CLI and Agent SDK make the execution and policy layers visible across interactive and programmable use.

repo_info.description: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.

children.title: Codex
children.description: An open-source coding harness spanning terminal, IDE, app, and cloud workflows. Its runtime combines repository tools, sandboxing, approvals, MCP, skills, subagents, compaction, resumable threads, and structured events. The shared runtime makes long-horizon work inspectable across surfaces, while OpenAI's harness engineering account shows how those controls shape sustained software work.

items.description:
A benchmark belongs here when it reveals something about the runtime around the model: component choice, state over time, recovery, permissions, auditability, protocol behavior, or evaluation infrastructure. Every result should identify the model, harness, environment, task version, budget, and evaluator together.
Environment drift, task ambiguity and harness coupling can complicate attribution. These are conditional explanatory paths; dashed cross-links describe interactions and lower annotations give controls, not measured effect sizes.
